title: Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster', White House says

 Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster', White House says
 34 minutes ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Jaroslav Lukiv Ksenia Arkhipova These residents were able to get out of Oleshky in spring this year US First Lady Melania Trump has "successfully secured" a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, the White House has said.
 The statement said the truce in the "front-line war city on the brink of disaster" would begin on 29 October, though Ukraine and Russia have so far not commented.
 "Oleshky's remaining population is comprised primarily of elderly residents who urgently need medical attention, medicine, food, and clean water," it added.
 Oleshky, in the Kherson region, was seized by Russian forces during the first days of Moscow's full-scale invasion in February 2022. Remaining residents have recently resorted to eating garden weeds to survive.

 The disease, which usually affects cattle, has been identified in a patient who died in early October.
 1 day ago 2 days ago Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
 Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.
